title: "[Feature] "

## Problem and desired outcome

Describe the use case and the behavior that would solve it.

## Proposed change

Identify the affected components and any alternatives considered.

## Evidence constraints

Explain any effects on allowed actions, provenance, deterministic verification, abstention/stopping, or reporting from fixed facts. If proposing AlphaGenome Atlas integration, explicitly distinguish it from the current standalone cross-reference.

## Acceptance criteria

Describe observable outcomes and appropriate validation.

## Data and configuration

List required resource types and configuration changes using neutral placeholders. Do not attach secrets, weights, databases, large results, or user-specific server paths.
